2609.28395.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Translation: General Forgetting Mitigation Does Not Preserve MT-Specific Instruction Following
2609.28395.paper_summary: Fine-tuning large language models on parallel data improves translation quality but can cause catastrophic forgetting. Mitigation methods are generally evaluated by retention on general benchmarks. We ask whether these findings transfer to machine translation (MT) fine-tuning and to MT-specific instruction following (MT-IF): instructions that modify a translation, such as formality, grammatical gender, and length control. We compare methods anchored to auxiliary data, to model outputs, and to the base model parameters, first in a screening study with Llama 3.2 1B Instruct, then on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct fine-tuned on bidirectional Arabic-English or Spanish-English data. Elastic Weight Consolidation preserves general capabilities best in both stages; on the 8B Spanish model the average score on general benchmarks drops 1.7 points versus 11.0 for standard fine-tuning, yet its scores for formality and grammatical gender control remain close to standard fine-tuning. Only data mixing with control-task examples preserves these controls, but its gains do not transfer to unseen prompts for the same task.
2609.28395.paper_summary_zh: 微調大型語言模型在平行數據上的表現能提升翻譯質量，但可能會導致災難性遺忘。減緩方法通常通過在一般基準上的保留率來評估。我們詢問這些發現是否能轉移到機器翻譯（MT）微調以及特定於MT的指令遵循（MT-IF）：修改翻譯的指令，例如正式性、語法性別和長度控制。我們比較了與輔助數據、模型輸出和基礎模型參數相關的方法，首先在使用Llama 3.2 1B Instruct的篩選研究中，然後在使用Llama 3.1 8B Instruct微調的雙向阿拉伯語-英語或西班牙語-英語數據上。彈性權重整合在兩個階段中都能最佳地保留一般能力；在8B西班牙模型上，與標準微調相比，平均分數在一般基準上下降了1.7分，而標準微調則下降了11.0分，但其在正式性和語法性別控制上的分數仍接近標準微調。只有與控制任務示例混合數據才能保留這些控制，但其增益並不會轉移到相同任務的未見提示上。
